theme: An open day before tomorrow's handoff.
greeting: An open Saturday with the girls, Dan — nothing on the calendar, so the day bends to the kitchen and whatever the afternoon wants. The one thing carrying a clock is the knot of overdue travel decisions, and tomorrow's Sunday review is where they get untied.

needsAttention.title: Tomorrow's Sunday review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: On your calendar at 9 AM — the 15-minute weekly board triage. The agenda writes itself: the stack of overdue travel items below. Arrive having decided December, so the review can promote and chase rather than relitigate.

needsAttention.title: December trip still has no destination
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 30 decide-by has passed and book-by is Oct 15, over the thinnest holiday inventory of the year. Passports aren't in hand until November, so it's a domestic shortlist or refundable-only international — pick one lane and commit.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV isn't booked yet
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out and prices up early. A refundable hold now costs nothing and removes the whole risk — the Pathfinder is south by then, so there's no six-seater in Maine otherwise.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south, Oct 5-18
needsAttention.detail: The off-week window opens tomorrow. Driving Portland to St. Pete replaces a flight rather than adding a trip, and it kills the monthly Florida rentals feeding the Oct 15 cost decision.

flagged.title: A LinkedIn message is waiting
flagged.detail: Noel messaged you on LinkedIn and it's sitting unanswered — worth a look given the board and role search.

flagged.title: Managing Director role at KPMG US
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn job alert flagged important; scan whether it's board-adjacent enough to pursue.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley statement is ready
flagged.detail: New account statement available online — no action, just a monthly glance.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and shop mail — NYT Cooking, the FT, Daily Italian, St. Pete local digests, two eBay delivery pings, and an AppleCare renewal receipt.

recipe.title: Roast chicken smothered with chanterelles
recipe.why: Autumn is peak chanterelle season, and cool afternoons make roasting a whole bird a pleasure again.

tasks.title: Portland house order — bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: A clear start — nothing on the calendar to open the weekend.
The afternoon is genuinely yours; only the overdue travel calls carry a clock.
A quiet evening in with the girls — the handoff lands tomorrow.
